rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: La Rochelle
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jan Spek Nurseries (Netherlands, before 2011).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2011 as 'La Rochelle'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Mild fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
